audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: 3-year average net profit margin for FY2015-FY2017 is 2.8%
audit_report.rationale: The analyst calculated the 3-year average as 2.8%, but verification shows (3.1 + 2.3 + 3.1) / 3 = 8.5 / 3 = 2.833..., which rounds to 2.8% when rounded to one decimal place. However, examining the individual margin calculations: 2015: 1233/40339 = 3.056% (rounds to 3.1%), 2016: 897/39528 = 2.269% (rounds to 2.3%), 2017: 1228/39403 = 3.113% (rounds to 3.1%). The average of exact values is (3.056 + 2.269 + 3.113) / 3 = 2.813%, which rounds to 2.8%. The reported value is correct.
